## 🇩🇪 German — Daily Phrases (3)
1. **Das spricht mich an** — [das shpriHt miH an] — *That resonates with me / speaks to me*
2. **Ich bin ganz bei der Sache** — [iH bin gants bye dehr ZA-khuh] — *I'm fully focused on what I'm doing*
3. **Es läuft wie am Schnürchen** — [es loyft vee am SHNÜR-shen] — *It's going smoothly (like clockwork)*
